0.comment: Odette: Violetta and the Spessiva family
0.content: Violetta Spessiva comes from an old family of Korolevskiy ballerinas whose glory had long faded. Little remained but yellowing portraits in a draughty house and the family's classic ballet "Spirit Seeker". She was a demanding teacher: one misplaced foot meant starting over. When her husband died, she went back to rehearsals, collapsed onstage during a performance and was told she would probably never dance the hardest steps again. She went on teaching Odette from a wheelchair, beating time with her cane, and refused Signora's offer to take her daughter. Canon does not say she has died; Odette's old dream was to earn enough to support her.

1.content: Signora, Eighth of the Harbingers, was Odette's father's commanding officer. She came at Capitano's behest to offer condolences, noticed the girl's agility, and offered to take her into the Fatui with an allowance for the family. When the child insisted, she answered coldly, "Then come along. Let us see how long that resolve of yours lasts." Her training was brutal: cold, collapse, injury, illness, constant pressure to live up to the Fair Lady's name. Odette resented her and practised ballet in defiance. When Signora caught her one night, Odette said she did not deserve to watch the dance her mother had taught her. Signora said nothing, left, and never interfered again. Odette now says she is indebted to her.

2.comment: Odette: The Cor Ignis and the Sanctuary of Grief
2.content: Signora gave favoured subordinates a Cor Ignis, her flame sealed in ice. It was a mark of favour, and she always knew where each one was. When she died, many crushed theirs with relief. Odette kept hers, because its warmth was one of the few sensations she still felt clearly. She lent it to Paimon as a cold remedy. At the Armory Palace, as the Curse of Death took her, she pressed it to the Traveler on a hunch, and it guided their soul back early.

3.content: The Rokot is a non-violent, anonymous Snezhnayan organisation that serves ordinary people and opposes Project Stuzha. As "Lelek", Odette was its most infamous agent. Lelek slipped into guarded rooms leaving no trace, left threatening letters, and frightened corrupt elites into line; the press cheered "We stand with Lelek!" Industrialist Chugunov's unexpected vote against Stuzha was put down to Lelek. Sandrone and Tartaglia used Odette's skill as a benchmark, and Sandrone realised she fitted the profile and had a motive.

4.content: The Korolevskiy Troupe's prima donna, a Water Imp, is one of the few people Odette speaks freely with. They met through backstage work: Odette calmed nervous newcomers with rehearsal logic while Vodyanitsa fired them up. Later Odette secretly gave Vodyanitsa her last honey candy "for your throat", not knowing a Water Imp's voice barely strains. Now Vodyanitsa packs three boxes of candy into Odette's bag and demands one back, swears she has caught her smiling, and makes her read fan letters. Odette says the smile was "simply the expression the role called for."

5.content: Odette met the Traveler at the collapsing Svetloledovka mine, warned them off, then took them for the backup from Snezhnograd. Together they drove off a burrowing monster and evacuated five miners. She was startled when the Traveler criticised two Harbingers to their faces, and visibly shaken when Tartaglia revealed they had duelled Signora. At Zolnyy she told them it was no hard feelings and helped them buy and ship Kristall to the poor. She then came to Podvorye Restaurant with candy and her Cor Ignis for the ailing Paimon.
